notes.title: Try our new puzzle game Abrix the robot
notes.notes:
Try to beat 76 levels in our new game Abrix the robot:
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=503901835
If you like it - [b]vote Yes now[/b] and help this game pass the Greenlight process.

Abrix robot got stuck in a room full of containers, crates and other handicaps during the cleanup work. Help him find the way out of the room.
Abrix the robot is an addictive puzzle game for everyone. While traveling on over 70 different rooms you will encounter a variety of obstacles which removal will require using your brain.

Can you finish all of them? 

[b]Play free demo or buy beta version now and save up to 44% before it reaches Steam (every buyer of beta version will receive a Steam key).[/b]

notes.title: Update 1.4 released!
notes.notes:
Following your suggestions we have made many changes and bug fixes in the game. We encourage you to download the new version of Ferrum's secrets.

Update 1.4 contains:
[list]
[*] Speech texts stay much longer
[*] Enabled to skip speech texts
[*] Enabled to skip many cutscenes
[*] Fixed Hint button that sometimes didn't work in hidden-object locations
[*] Enabled to leave hidden-object locations and mini-games
[*] Instruction button more visible
[*] Showing mini-game instruction before game start
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.3 released!
notes.notes:
We encourage you to download the new version of Ferrum's secrets.

Update 1.3 contains:
- Button "windowed mode" that enables switching between full screen and window
- Achievements will now be collected during game not after closing game
- Slower dialogues
- Fixed many minor bugs: glitches, translation bugs
